That’s a wrap on my internship at Interac Corp.! 🎉 Over the past few months, I learned a lot through market research on international remittance, managing release notes, and collaborating with the OAS team on new features. Big thanks to my manager Deepesh Mukundan, Raymond Young, Victor Lavrentyev, Jacky Huang, Maj Dafinone and the whole Interac team for the support. I’m grateful to have learned from such a talented group! Bonus highlight: my 2.5-hour commute gave me way too much time to think 😅

I’m excited to share that I’ll be joining Interac this summer in Toronto as a Technical Product Analyst Intern. Really grateful to everyone who helped me out along the way — big thanks to Raymond Young for referring me, Victor Lavrentyev for the interview, and Luke Blommesteyn for helping me prep. Looking forward to learning a ton, meeting great people, and making the most of this opportunity.
